scope: Current distribution inputs and latest published release; earlier investigations are archived separately.

license_decision.x264: Excluded from the release engine; built-in H.264 decoding is retained
license_decision.unicode_dfs_2016: Accepted as GPL-compatible; original notice retained in the packaged dependency inventory
license_decision.approval_scope: This records the repository license choice and reviewed compatibility decisions. It does not mark an unbuilt package as verified.

release_verification_remaining: Build and verify the next application package and its exact extracted executable. The existing native engine can be reused.

development_engine.scope: Development input only; not the engine used in release packages.

release_candidate_policy.reuse: A matching CI artifact or published release package; verify source/build identity, manifest hashes and notices.
release_candidate_policy.runtime_assembly: Windows x86_64 runtime with static CRT for riina.exe; exact archive import, source-access and extracted-application checks required.
release_candidate_policy.source_access: Immutable application tag, Cargo.lock, SOURCE-MANIFEST.tsv and public pinned native repositories. Do not duplicate full native or vendored source trees in download assets.

release_engine.restoration_verification: Archive checksum, immutable release source, unchanged native contract, complete runtime hashes and source notices verified locally on 2026-10-19.

native_tests.scope: Decode/command/lifecycle tests; not physical-display, audible-output or HDR certification.

historical_evidence.scope: Prior development-engine investigations, failed candidates and original 0.3.0 distribution evidence; not current release state.

latest_candidate_attempt.result: Application package built and engine tests passed; extracted application exited 1 before producing its smoke report. The old launcher did not retain its error output, so cause remains unknown. No release published.
latest_candidate_attempt.follow_up: Retain exact process stdout/stderr, unverified package and successful compiler cache on failure; repeat the candidate after the menu regression batch.
